title: Term of the Closing Charge on a Refined Fuels Account Long Unpaid
content:
The closing charge on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts runs for a term fixed by how long it is since the account was last paid and whether the truck has been to the site in the recent quarter.

**Where the account was last paid at least 2 months ago and 1 or more stops were billed on it in the three months ending on the handling date**, the closing charge runs for the whole months since the account was last paid.

**Where the account was last paid at least 2 months ago and no stop was billed on it in that window**, the closing charge runs for the whole months since the account was last paid together with the month the account closes in.

**Where the account was last paid more recently than 2 months ago**, the closing charge runs for one month.

| Whole months since the account was last paid | Stops billed in the three months ending on the handling date | The closing charge runs for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | 1 or more | Those whole months |
| 2 or more | None | Those whole months, and the month the account closes in as well |
| Fewer than 2 | Either way | One month |

The months are whole months counted from the day of the most recent payment to the handling date, and the test is met at 2 months exactly.

*Hypothetical.* An account last paid 5 months before the handling date, with 2 stops billed in the quarter, carries a closing charge running 5 months. The same account with no stop billed in that quarter carries one running 6 months. An account last paid 1 month before the handling date carries one running a single month, whichever way the stops fell.
